middle:
ACCIDENT SCENE. The poop is near the middle of the frame, and the investigation has gone wrong. Where this conflicts with the poses, gas-mask rules, or gaze rules in sections 2, 5, 6, 11, 12, and 14, this section wins.

The Hazardous-Material Specialist has passed out face up on the pavement on the left side of the poop. It looks unconscious, not injured: no blood, no visible harm, feathers intact, still wearing its yellow vest. Its gas mask has come off and lies on the pavement nearby, between the bird and the poop.

The equipment line (the case, the camera on its tripod, and the detector) sits on the right side of the poop. The Curious Investigator has left its post: it stands in front of the equipment line, closer to the camera, caught mid-stride toward the viewer, and looks directly into the lens, as though walking up to report the incident. Its pose and expression stay natural and pigeon-like, never human.

The poop stays clearly visible in the middle, inside the evidence markers.
